bpmn2:process.studyflow:documentation: Figure 7: the single source file whose Schedule (Gantt), Checklist (audit), and Participant-flow (CONSORT) views are all projections. Activities carry onset/duration for the Gantt; the eligibility and allocation nodes carry declared criteria; boundary error events carry the post-run counts.
